responsibility: This header declares the function_base objects that represent the base set of AArch64 SVE intrinsic semantics. It exposes one extern pointer per intrinsic operation in namespace aarch64_sve::functions so that the SVE builtin registration code can reference the operation implementations defined in aarch64-sve-builtins-base.cc when constructing builtin function instances.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-base trio, this header is the symbol declaration layer: it declares the extern function_base objects for base SVE intrinsics so other builtin code can reference implementations from the .cc file, while the .def file supplies the intrinsic table entries.
